summary: Most Python-based core modules do not work on Windows, so you need the Windows collections such as ansible.windows, community.windows, microsoft.ad and chocolatey.chocolatey. A set of core modules and action plugins still works on Windows, including debug, fetch, raw, script, setup, slurp, template and wait_for_connection.

answer_card.title: Which modules work on Windows hosts
answer_card.answer_md:
Python-based core modules don't run on Windows. Use the Windows collections instead: `ansible.windows`, `community.windows`, `microsoft.ad` and `chocolatey.chocolatey`.

Core modules and action plugins that do work on Windows: `add_host`, `assert`, `async_status`, `debug`, `fail`, `fetch`, `group_by`, `include`, `include_role`, `include_vars`, `meta`, `pause`, `raw`, `script`, `set_fact`, `set_stats`, `setup`, `slurp`, `template` (there is also `win_template`), and `wait_for_connection`.
